display_long_description:
POTATO CLIMBER is a fast-paced vertical VR climbing game where precision, rhythm, and speed determine how high you can go.

Your hands are flat potato climbers, perfectly designed to grip small flat surfaces, allowing incredibly smooth and rapid climbing.

The goal is simple:

Climb as high and as fast as possible.

But reaching the top is not easy.

The levels are filled with tiny platforms, narrow grips, and challenging obstacle routes that require quick movement and perfect timing.

Master the movement system to climb faster, find better routes, and beat your best time.

Core Gameplay

Ultra Fast Vertical Climbing
Use your flat potato hands to scale vertical environments rapidly.

Small Surface Grip Mechanics
Your potato climbers can attach to many small surfaces, enabling fast climbing routes.

Obstacle Course Climbing
Navigate difficult climbing paths filled with tight grips and tricky routes.

Speed Climbing Challenge
Climb faster and faster as you master the controls.

Score & Time Challenges
Beat your personal records and reach new heights.

Key Features

• Smooth and fast VR climbing mechanics
• Unique flat potato climbing hands
• Challenging vertical obstacle courses
• Speed climbing gameplay
• Designed for fast movement and fluid climbing

The Challenge

Climb higher.
Climb faster.
Find the fastest routes.

Only the best climbers will reach the top. Climbing vertical obstacle course with precision and speedrun.
